name: Hejour
soft_passes: #3 silhouette nameable only via hue knockout; solid-filled it is a plain rounded square
#4 16px: white tile survives on yellow but the checkmark detail risks washing (nil value contrast, saved by thick stroke)
#5 single light model passes only because it is wholly flat — no modeled light to be inconsistent
#9 borrows the Big Sur squircle format with zero Big Sur depth and no Liquid Glass — reads a generation behind macOS 26
#10 shape survives dark/tinted but it is a flat bitmap, not an Icon Composer layered/glass icon; identity rides on the field colour
failures: #7 figure-ground contrast: white card vs yellow field measures 1.24:1, checkmark yellow-on-white same; collapses in grayscale, relies purely on hue
light_model: None — pure flat fills; no modeled light source, no baked micro-shadow, no specular, no gradient ramp.
layer_stack: checkmark knockout (yellow field revealed through the card — negative space, not an added front layer)
devices: squircle-in-squircle: inner white card echoes the system mask superellipse
knockout glyph: checkmark is negative space (field bleeding through the card), same colour as the field
mono-hue-plus-white economy: one committed brand colour, zero gradient, zero depth
rhymes_hint: flat iOS-superellipse knockout icons — a single glyph knocked out of a saturated single-hue flat field; checklist/todo-app vernacular (checkmark family, Things-adjacent but flatter, depthless)
notes: Source is 1221x1107 NON-square (resized web render, not the 1024 master) — inner-card proportions estimated, but flat-fill hex are reliable. Icon-vs-app palette disconnect: icon is canary yellow #FEE90A while the app UI is a dark charcoal editor (#1E1E1E) with a green completion accent (~#49901A); the icon's yellow appears nowhere in the product. Off-subject glyph: a checkmark says 'to-do/done', but Hejour is a day-based notebook/writing app — the icon communicates the checklist sliver, not the journal core. Not authored as Liquid Glass; single flat bitmap.
